title: Maelzel — Metronome, tempo training, and setlists
description: Try all metronome and rhythm-training features for 72 hours, then unlock lifetime use with one purchase. No automatic charge, subscription, or renewal.
headline:
A steady click.
A practice of your own.
intro: Set the tempo, shape the beat, and spend time with your instrument. Maelzel combines a clear metronome with rhythm challenges, songs, setlists, and a practice log—without an account or a subscription.
tagline: A precise click, with room to grow beyond it.
cardHeadline: A precise metronome, tempo training and setlists for time with your instrument.
purchaseNote: Every feature is free to try for 3 days (72 hours) from your original trial purchase. After that, continuing to use the metronome and trainer requires a one-time lifetime purchase. There is no automatic charge and no renewal. Reinstalling, restoring purchases, or importing a backup does not restart the trial.

steps.title: Set your beat
steps.text: Use the ivory tempo ruler or tap tempo. Choose a meter, accents, a subdivision, and a sound, then start a run at a comfortable pace.

steps.title: Give your timing a challenge
steps.text: Try a tempo ladder that remembers where you got stuck, growing gaps, randomly muted bars, offbeat patterns, or polyrhythms. All are available during the 72-hour trial.

steps.title: Keep a practice record
steps.text: Save songs and setlists, use Live mode, and review your complete practice log. Your records stay saved and exportable even if you do not buy after the trial.

features.title: The click you need
features.text: Custom meters, per-beat accents, nine subdivisions, and six sounds let you shape a useful pulse. Playback continues in the background or with the screen locked.

features.title: Training beyond a faster number
features.text: A remembering tempo ladder, gaps, muted bars, offbeats, and polyrhythms turn steady time into specific practice challenges.

features.title: Songs, setlists, and continuity
features.text: Keep songs and setlists ready for Live mode and retain a complete practice log. Data settings and backup export/import remain available after the trial expires.

included: Every metronome, trainer, song, setlist, Live mode, and practice-log feature during the 72-hour trial
Saved records and record export remain available after trial expiry
Data settings and backup export/import remain available after trial expiry
premium: One-time lifetime purchase to continue metronome and trainer use after the trial
Continued access to the full feature set without a subscription or renewal
Restore the purchase with the same Apple Account
privacy: No app account or advertising. Practice records are kept on your device.
Purchases and entitlement checks use Apple and RevenueCat. App updates use Expo; local activity storage does not mean the app never connects to the internet.
Backup export and import are manual file actions. Keep a copy somewhere private if you need to move your records.
limitations: The trial is 72 hours from its original purchase, not three days from each reinstall. Nothing is charged automatically when it ends.
An incoming call stops playback. Press Play afterward to start a new run; automatic resumption is not promised.
